part.text:
Fixed `src/t_zset.c:4345` so `BZMPOP` blocks only on its actual key arguments instead of every argument between the command and timeout (which included `numkeys`, `MIN/MAX`, and `COUNT` values). This mirrors the existing BLMPOP/list blocking implementation.

Validated with the full `unit/type/zset` suite, including `BZMPOP should not blocks on non key arguments - #10762`: all tests pass.
